Welcome to the experiment!

In this experiment, you will be asked to make judgments about the content of different sentences. On each trial, you will read a sentence, and will be shown a picture immediately following the sentence. Your task is to decide whether the object displayed in the picture was mentioned in the sentence or not and respond as quickly as possible by pressing A for yes or L for no.

You will now do a practice session with feedback and instructions. Click the button below to continue.
